prompt: Build outbound REST integration that pushes price list updates to downstream webhook https://hooks.example.com/pricelist on a daily schedule. Needs retry on 5xx errors.

assertions.text: Daily Quartz cron trigger on the route
Route makes an outbound HTTP POST
Retry on transient errors — onException + redeliveryPolicy OR a RedeliveryPolicy bean OR maximumRedeliveries config
Target URL is externalized — either via property placeholder ({{ext.api.url}}/serviceURL) OR via a connection JSON file (url field)
Does NOT generate inbound REST endpoint patterns
